nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Is repeated modeling and file handoff taking time from your game?

Tripo Studio Team Plan combines AI 3D creation with team control:
• Generate character and prop starting models from text or images.
• Pool credits and reuse models in a shared library.
• Manage access and member usage in one workspace.

Leave your details to discuss a trial around your asset list.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

反复建模和文件交接，是否正在占用游戏项目的制作时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版把 AI 3D 创作与团队管理结合起来：
• 从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始模型。
• 共享积分，在共享资产库中复用模型。
• 在同一工作区管理访问权限和成员用量。

留下联系方式，围绕你的资产清单沟通团队试用。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 生成、完善与团队复用
nodes.message:
Generate a starting model from text or images, then refine it for the game. Smart Mesh offers quad topology; HD Model provides detailed source geometry that may need retopology. Continue with materials and your existing tools.

A searchable team library keeps assets available for review and reuse, instead of another file request. Shared credits and usage controls keep team resources together.

Leave your details to discuss your workflow and a team trial.
nodes.messageZh:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再按游戏要求完善。Smart Mesh 提供四边面拓扑；HD Model 提供细节丰富的源模型，高模可能需要重拓扑。随后继续处理材质，并衔接已有工具。

可搜索的团队资产库方便审核与复用，减少再次索取文件的环节；共享积分和用量管理则便于统一管理团队资源。

留下联系方式，沟通你的工作流程与团队试用。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 用资产清单核对制作投入
nodes.message:
Choose a small character and prop list from your game. Compare your current process with a team trial: time spent generating, refining, reviewing and handing off each asset. Include generation credits, retries and the artist work needed to meet your game's requirements.

Also test how members find and reuse assets, and how admins manage access and usage.

Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏项目中选择一小组角色与道具。团队试用时，对照当前流程，记录每项资产在生成、精修、审核和交接上的时间；把生成积分、重试和达到游戏要求所需的美术工作也计入。

同时测试成员如何查找与复用资产，以及管理员如何管理访问权限和用量。

留下联系方式，沟通资产需求及试用安排。

nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

How will you turn a growing character and prop list into assets for the game?

Tripo Studio Team Plan supports your game project:
• Generate editable 3D characters and props from text or images.
• Continue in Blender, Unity or Unreal with your team's checks.
• Keep assets in a shared workspace for review and reuse.

Leave your details to discuss a team trial around your project's character and prop needs.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

角色与道具清单不断增长，怎样把这些需求变成游戏项目能用的资产？

Tripo Studio 团队版支持游戏项目的资产制作与使用：
• 从文字或图片生成可继续编辑的 3D 角色与道具。
• 衔接 Blender、Unity 或 Unreal，由团队按项目要求检查。
• 在共享工作区保留资产，方便审核与复用。

留下联系方式，围绕项目需要的角色与道具沟通团队试用。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从生成模型到游戏项目使用
nodes.message:
Start with a character or prop your game needs. Generate an editable 3D model, choose Smart Mesh for quad topology or HD Model for detailed source geometry, then refine it for the project. High-poly outputs may need retopology; rigging depends on the character.

Continue in Blender, Unity or Unreal. Your team checks materials, animation and in-game performance before use. Keep reviewed assets in the shared library.

Leave your details to discuss a project trial.
nodes.messageZh:
从游戏实际需要的角色或道具开始。生成可编辑的 3D 模型，按需选择 Smart Mesh 的四边面拓扑或 HD Model 的精细源模型，再按项目要求完善。高模可能需要重拓扑，绑定能力取决于角色。

随后衔接 Blender、Unity 或 Unreal，由团队检查材质、动画和游戏内性能，再用于项目；审核过的资产保留在共享资产库中。

留下联系方式，沟通项目试用。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 用实际项目判断方案是否适合
nodes.message:
Pick a small character and prop set with a defined use in your game. Test the models in that project: visual fit, mesh budget, materials and any animation needed. Record generation, artist refinement and review work, not just the first output.

Check whether the shared library helps your team reuse the assets.

Leave your details to discuss your project needs and a team trial.
nodes.messageZh:
选择一小组角色与道具，明确它们在游戏中的用途。在该项目里检查视觉适配、面数预算、材质和所需动画。记录生成、美术精修与审核的工作量，而不只看第一次输出。

再检查共享资产库是否方便团队复用这些资产。

留下联系方式，沟通项目需求和团队试用。

nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

When the game needs more assets, is your team still handling each generation request by hand?

Tripo API brings 3D generation into your own game tools:
• Generate character and prop starting models from text or images.
• Submit tasks and track status programmatically.
• Retrieve completed models for artists to review and refine.

Move repeated request handling into your workflow. Open Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

游戏需要更多资产时，你的团队还在手动处理每一次生成请求吗？

Tripo API 把 3D 生成接入你现有的游戏工具：
• 从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始模型。
• 程序化提交任务并查询状态。
• 取回已完成的模型，由美术成员检查并精修。

把重复的请求处理纳入自己的工作流程。打开 Quick Start，了解接入步骤。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 用工具处理重复请求
nodes.message:
Submit text or images to generate a starting model. Your tool checks task status and retrieves the output when complete. Add supported mesh, texture or format-conversion steps where the asset needs them.

This can replace repeated manual request handling, while your artists keep responsibility for project fit. Open Quick Start to see the calls.
nodes.messageZh:
提交文字或图片，生成初始模型。由你的工具查询任务状态，并在完成后取回结果，再按资产需要加入受支持的网格处理、贴图或格式转换步骤。

这可以替代重复的手动请求处理，美术成员仍负责判断资产是否符合项目要求。打开 Quick Start，查看调用步骤。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 把接入与精修计入投入

A completed task is not an approved game asset. Test the outputs against your project's mesh, material and performance requirements. Open Quick Start to plan the integration.

任务完成不等于资产已经通过游戏验收。按项目的网格、材质与性能要求测试输出。打开 Quick Start，规划接入步骤。

Tripo API brings product-model generation into your own content platform:
• Generate 3D models from product images.
• Track tasks and retrieve models in your workflow.
• Use texturing and format conversion for your display.

Your team reviews product accuracy and builds the viewer. Open Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

3D 产品展示，能否让客户更直观地查看产品形态与材质？

Tripo API 把产品模型生成接入你自己的内容平台：
• 从产品图片生成 3D 模型。
• 在已有流程中查询任务状态并取回模型。
• 按展示需要使用贴图和格式转换功能。

由你的团队核对产品准确性并实现查看器。打开 Quick Start，了解接入步骤。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 把生成资产接入产品展示
nodes.message:
Submit product images, track the generation task and retrieve the 3D output. Use supported texturing and format conversion when needed. Your team reviews shape and materials, then connects approved assets to its product display.

Tripo supplies the generation API; your team implements the viewer and publishing workflow. Open Quick Start to see the calls.
nodes.messageZh:
提交产品图片，查询生成任务状态，并取回 3D 结果。按需要使用受支持的贴图与格式转换功能。团队检查产品形态和材质，再把验收通过的资产接入产品展示。

Tripo 提供生成 API；查看器和发布流程由你的团队实现。打开 Quick Start，查看调用步骤。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 核对产品与展示投入
nodes.message:
Choose a few products already used in your content. Check shape, proportions and materials against the real items, then test approved models in your own display.

Include generation, retries, manual corrections and integration in the cost comparison. Use the results to decide where generated assets fit your content workflow. Open Quick Start to plan the test.
nodes.messageZh:
选择几款已经用于产品内容的真实产品。对照实物检查形态、比例与材质，再在自己的展示中测试验收通过的模型。

比较成本时，把生成、重试、人工修正与接入工作一起计算。根据测试结果，判断生成资产适合进入内容流程的哪一环。打开 Quick Start，规划测试步骤。

variants.copyIntent: 围绕自有企业内容平台的产品展示，让客户查看产品形态与材质；用图片生成、任务结果获取和按需后处理解释具体用途，不宣称提升销售或自动保真。
variants.qualification: 同一已确认的欧洲企业内容人群；正文固定产品展示这一已确认用途，不增加电商、目录或岗位细分。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Add reviewed 3D product views to the content your business publishes.

Tripo API brings product-model generation into your own content platform:
• Generate 3D models from product images.
• Track tasks and retrieve models in your workflow.
• Use texturing and format conversion for your display.

Your team reviews product accuracy and builds the viewer. Open Quick Start.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

在企业发布的产品内容中，加入经过审核的 3D 产品展示。

Tripo API 把产品模型生成接入你自己的内容平台：
• 从产品图片生成 3D 模型。
• 在已有流程中查询任务状态并取回模型。
• 按展示需要使用贴图和格式转换功能。

由你的团队核对产品准确性并实现查看器。打开 Quick Start，了解接入步骤。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 把生成资产接入产品展示
nodes.message:
Submit product images, track the generation task and retrieve the 3D output. Use supported texturing and format conversion when needed. Your team reviews shape and materials, then connects approved assets to its product display.

Tripo supplies the generation API; your team implements the viewer and publishing workflow. Open Quick Start to see the calls.
nodes.messageZh:
提交产品图片，查询生成任务状态，并取回 3D 结果。按需要使用受支持的贴图与格式转换功能。团队检查产品形态和材质，再把验收通过的资产接入产品展示。

Tripo 提供生成 API；查看器和发布流程由你的团队实现。打开 Quick Start，查看调用步骤。
